# SYNESIS_E072 — Error

## Description

Entry `@key` in `file.syn` is not valid BibTeX.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The entry `@key` in the references file `file.syn`
  is not valid BibTeX and was ignored by the compiler. Because of
  that, any `@bibref` pointing to it will be reported as not
  found.
  A valid BibTeX entry has three parts: a type, the citation key
  in braces, and comma-separated fields using `=`:
    @book{key,
        title = {Title of the work},
        year = {2024}
    }
  Check that the entry starts with a type (@book, @article, @misc...),
  that the key is in braces `{ }`, and that each field uses `=` (not `:`).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MalformedBibliographyEntry**: `filename`, `entry_key`
